data.name: Procurement Email Intake — TA Form + Report
data.description: Watches ahmadsho2390+intake@gmail.com — no manual labeling. Batches pending quotations against the arriving PR, dedups/handles revisions, extracts + generates the TA Form and Report, and emails the engineer with an Approve link and four attachments: the HTML analytics dashboard (per-supplier reliability scores, cost comparison, risk flags), the TA Form, the Report, and an MP3 audio summary when a TTS secret (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY or GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY) is configured. Nothing is sent to any supplier until that link is clicked (procurement-approval-confirm handles it) — a close runner-up with exactly one fixable gap (payment terms, warranty, or delivery) gets a negotiation counter-request instead of a flat rejection. Supplier email is recovered from a genuine Gmail forward's embedded sender when present, falling back to the message's direct sender otherwise. Failures are precise: only a message that can never succeed on retry gets labeled failed; transient or incomplete-batch conditions just wait for the next poll.

documentation.requirementsMarkdown:
# Procurement Email Intake — TA Form + Report

## What this integration does
This workflow automates the intake, comparison, and review process for incoming procurement requests and supplier quotations sent via email. It monitors a designated Gmail inbox, identifies Purchase Requisitions (PR) alongside attached vendor quotes, and extracts key commercial terms, pricing, lead times, and warranties. It generates a comprehensive analysis suite—including an HTML interactive analytics dashboard, a Technical Approval (TA) form, a PDF procurement report, and an optional spoken MP3 summary—and emails the engineer with an approval link before notifying any suppliers.

## Before you start
- Connect Google Gmail with permissions to search, read, modify labels, and send messages.
- Ensure the Gmail intake address (`ahmadsho2390+intake@gmail.com`) is set up to receive PRs and supplier quotes.
- Verify that Gmail labels `procurement-processed`, `procurement-failed`, and `procurement-awaiting-approval` can be created or accessed.
- Ensure incoming quotation and PR attachments are in supported file formats (`.pdf`, `.docx`, `.doc`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`).
- Optional: Add `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` (and optionally `ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID`) or `GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY` in environment secrets to enable automatic voice summary MP3 generation.

## Connected apps
| App | Role | What it does |
|-----|------|-------------|
| Google Gmail | Both | Reads incoming PR and quote emails, updates message tracking labels, and sends review packages with attachments to engineers. |

## How it works
1. **Scans Gmail for new procurement emails** — Searches the inbox for unprocessed messages containing attachments sent to the designated intake address.
2. **Parses message headers and attachments** — Identifies whether each attachment is a Purchase Requisition or a vendor quotation, and extracts original sender addresses from forwarded headers.
3. **Flags invalid messages** — Marks messages lacking valid document attachments with the failed label so they are not reprocessed.
4. **Verifies complete submission batches** — Checks that at least one PR and one quotation exist before proceeding; otherwise, it pauses until remaining documents arrive in subsequent polls.
5. **Deduplicates and updates quote revisions** — Detects duplicate quotes and automatically replaces older versions when an updated quote file is received.
6. **Downloads requisition and quotation files** — Fetches full file contents from Gmail for all distinct quotation files and the Purchase Requisition.
7. **Extracts structured procurement data** — Sends the files to the procurement analysis engine to extract commercial details, terms, costs, and risk flags.
8. **Generates TA forms and formal reports** — Creates a standardized Technical Approval Excel document and an executive PDF procurement report.
9. **Calculates supplier reliability and creates dashboard** — Scores each vendor across price, delivery, warranty, and risk, then compiles an interactive HTML analytics dashboard.
10. **Synthesizes audio executive summary** — Generates an MP3 audio summary of the procurement analysis if ElevenLabs or Google Cloud TTS API keys are configured.
11. **Identifies runner-up negotiation opportunities** — Detects close runner-up quotes with single fixable gaps (such as delivery or payment terms) to target for counter-proposals.
12. **Emails analysis package and approval link** — Sends the engineer an email reply containing the approval link, HTML dashboard, TA Form, PDF report, and MP3 audio summary.
13. **Labels processed emails as awaiting approval** — Updates the status of all processed messages in Gmail to prevent duplicate runs while waiting for engineer confirmation.

## Field mapping
| Source field | Destination field | Notes |
|-------------|------------------|-------|
| Gmail `From` / Forwarded Sender | Supplier Email / Reply Recipient | Preserves genuine forwarded sender when available, falling back to direct message sender. |
| Gmail Subject Header | Email Reply Subject | Prepends `Re:` to maintain email threading context. |
| Attachment File Name (`*pr*`, `*requisition*`) | Purchase Requisition Document | Identifies PR attachment based on file naming patterns. |
| Attachment File Name (non-PR) | Supplier Quotation Document | Grouped by unique filename and versioned by timestamp. |
| Supplier Total Cost USD | Analytics Dashboard & Report Cost | Normalized to USD for direct cross-vendor comparison. |
| Payment Terms & Warranty | TA Form & Reliability Breakdown | Evaluates terms against scoring benchmarks. |

## Smart features
- Smart forwarding resolution — extracts true supplier email addresses embedded inside forwarded Gmail bodies.
- Automated revision management — overwrites older quotes with newer versions while skipping exact duplicates.
- Weighted reliability scoring — rates suppliers from 0 to 100 based on price, delivery speed, payment terms, warranty, and risk.
- Negotiation counter-request detection — tags runner-up vendors within 20% price range for targeted negotiation rather than flat rejection.
- Multi-modal reporting — bundles an interactive HTML dashboard, Excel TA form, PDF report, and AI-generated MP3 audio.
- Incomplete batch patience — waits for pending PRs or quotations across polling cycles without failing prematurely.

## When it runs
- **Scheduled trigger**: Runs automatically every 3 minutes (UTC) to poll the intake mailbox.
- **Webhook trigger**: Can be triggered on demand via HTTP POST with PR and quotation file payloads.
- **Progress tracking**: Tracks state using Gmail labels (`procurement-awaiting-approval`, `procurement-processed`, `procurement-failed`).

## Troubleshooting
| What you see | Likely cause | What to check |
|--------------|--------------|---------------|
| Status returns `waiting-for-pr` | Quotations arrived but no file named with `pr` or `requisition` was found | Check that the PR attachment filename includes "pr" or "requisition". |
| Status returns `waiting-for-quotations` | A PR was received but no supplier quote files were attached | Ensure vendor quote attachments are present in `.pdf`, `.docx`, or image format. |
| Email received without MP3 audio | No Text-to-Speech API secrets configured, or API limit reached | Check that `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_TTS_API_KEY` is configured in secrets. |
| Messages marked with `procurement-failed` | Message had unsupported attachment types or missing sender details | Ensure attachments are valid documents (`.pdf`, `.docx`, `.png`, `.jpg`). |

## Related links
- Connecting Google Gmail
- Configuring Procurement Intake Labels
- Setting Up Text-to-Speech API Secrets
